Not too many men in the UK get the better of Abi Ekoku when it comes to heaving the discus but our Field Captain received a shock from the hands of a club-mate on May 13th when in a representative match at Hayes Darin Morris got the better of him, 57.64 to 57.50.

Neil Hammersley was not happy with his 2nd place 400m hurdles race but worked it out of his system by spending the rest of the afternoon popping up in all sorts of jumps and sprints, while new member John Mackenzie made a big impact in the triple jump by winning the event with nearly two metres to spare.

But Cap'n Bob's efforts at changing tack seemed to be dashed at the very outset when Neil Hammersley pulled a muscle warming up for the 400 hurdles and Andy Paton, looking for spare points in the 'B' race, suddenly found himself promoted to the 'A' string and a possible 7 or 8 points became just 1!
